title: What is the difference between the Young Generation and the Old Generation memory spaces?
shortTitle: What is the difference between Young and Old Generation?

s1_definition.oneliner: Young Gen holds new short-lived objects, collected frequently and cheaply (Minor GC). Old Gen holds long-lived objects, collected rarely and expensively (Major/Full GC).
s1_definition.profdef:
- Young Gen: short-lived, fast GC, small
- Old Gen: long-lived, slow GC, large
- Most objects die in Young Gen (generational hypothesis)
- Promotion: objects surviving N GCs move to Old Gen

sections.s6_takeaway:
Young Gen holds new short-lived objects, collected frequently and cheaply (Minor GC). Old Gen holds long-lived objects, collected rarely and expensively (Major/Full GC).\n\n

Remember one sentence: What is the difference between the Young Generation and the Old Generation memory spaces is fundamental knowledge for Java interviews and production banking work.
